candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student Business Analyst position at Picnic. Using data to answer real business questions, and then convincing people to change how things are done, is what I did in consulting and want to keep doing alongside my M.Sc. studies.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before that I worked at TallyMarks Consulting in SAP data & analytics and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea, one of Pakistan's large consumer goods companies.

achievements.impact: at Tapal Tea I replaced a manual quality check, opening an SAP report for each of thousands of materials and compiling results in Excel, with a single SAP Analytics Cloud dashboard
at TallyMarks Consulting I independently rebuilt a client's spinning dashboard end to end (OEE, utilization, downtime, yield) as part of a 42-dashboard migration to SAP Datasphere
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who subsequently purchased it, and translated business requirements into KPI reporting

letter.problems_section: Whether I start in Consumer or Logistics, I would bring a structured, data-driven way of working: framing the question, getting the data with SQL and Python, and turning the answer into something a stakeholder can act on. Demand forecasting and pricing questions in particular connect directly to my Data Science studies.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week during the semester (more than your 16-hour minimum) and am happy to relocate to Düsseldorf. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am taking German classes (A1).
